name: CENNETIC 1165L Heavy-Duty Vertical Machining Center
summary: The 1165L is a heavy-duty vertical machining center engineered for aggressive material removal on large workpieces.
body:
The 1165L is a heavy-duty vertical machining center engineered for aggressive material removal on large workpieces.

Technical specifications

ItemUnitSpec
Spindle1pcsDANQUAN (Taiwan)
Screw bearing6setNSK / FAG / THK bearings
Ball screw3setHIWIN
Coupling3setRunde
Linear guideway3setHIWIN
Tool Magazine1setSFG (Taiwan)
System1setMitsubishi/Syntec
Motor4setMitsubishi/Syntec
Lubrication system1setHoval
Telescopic cover3setHongwang/Aipai'er

Equipment

Standard equipment

  • Bed — Cast Iron — Resin-sand casting (HT300)
  • Bed — Lubrication Circuit — Hoval (Auto lubrication)
  • Bed — Ball Screw — HIWIN (Taiwan)Ball screw (R40-12K5-FDC)
  • Bed — Linear Guideway — HIWIN (Taiwan)Linear guideway (X,Y,Z: HGH45CA)
  • Bed — Spindle — DANQUAN (Taiwan)Mechanical spindle (BT40(150)-12000rpm)
  • Electrical — Feed-motor type — X,Yservo (3.9 kW AM18 18.6 N·m 4000 rpm)
  • Electrical — Feed-motor type — Z-axis servo (braked) (5.9 kW AM28 28.4 N·m 4000 rpm)
  • Electrical — Spindle motor — Servo spindle motor (7.5-11 kW/12000 rpm)
  • System — CNC: Syntec (Taiwan) (22MA)
  • Tool Change — Pneumatic tool changer — SFG (Taiwan) (BT40 24 tools)
  • Appearance — Sheet-metal Enclosure — Full enclosure (Ivory + sky blue)
  • Lubrication — Electric oiler — RGB electric oiler (Electric oiler)
  • Lighting — Linear work lamp (LED)
  • Service — Freight — out-of-province
  • Service — Packing — Wooden-crate packing
  • Service — Warranty — 2 years
  • Service — Training — on-site

Optional equipment

  • Accessories — Tool holders / collets — BT40-ER32 (10 pcs each)
  • Accessories — Tool kit (1 pcs)
  • Accessories — Tool rack (1 pcs)
  • Accessories — Manual (1 set (incl. USB))

About this model

This Vertical Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
